boarding_points.name: Estação Governador Albuíno Azeredo (Aquaviário da Prainha)
boarding_points.notes: Vila Velha station of the relaunched aquaviário; R. Antônio Ataíde 246. Lines 402 (↔Praça do Papa) and 403 (↔Porto de Santana). Coordinate from CETURB's official station map link; OSM cross-check way 1089765042 (-20.32754, -40.29145) agrees within ~10 m.

boarding_points.name: Estação Prefeito Setembrino Pelissari (Aquaviário da Praça do Papa)
boarding_points.notes: Capital-side hub next to the Cais das Artes; lines 401 and 402. R$1.8M renovation ordered Mar 2026. Coordinate from CETURB's official station map link; OSM cross-check way 1106456872 (-20.31815, -40.29422) agrees within ~15 m.

boarding_points.name: Estação Prefeito Aloizio Santos (Aquaviário de Porto de Santana)
boarding_points.notes: Northwest-channel terminus, R. Manoel Coutinho 744; lines 401 and 403. Coordinate from CETURB's official station map link; OSM cross-check way 1089765040 (-20.30957, -40.36421) agrees within ~10 m.

boarding_points.name: Estação Élcio Álvares (Aquaviário da Rodoviária de Vitória)
boarding_points.linked_locale: Vitória (Ilha do Príncipe — intercity bus terminal)
boarding_points.notes: Fourth station, opened 29 May 2026; line 401 now calls here between Porto de Santana and Praça do Papa. Coordinate from OSM node 13726499568 'Estação Governador Élcio Álvares Rodoviária'; CETURB's map link points to the adjacent bus-terminal complex (-20.32167, -40.35162), ~150 m away.

boarding_points.name: Iate Clube do Espírito Santo
boarding_points.notes: The capital's principal yacht club on the sheltered water between Praia do Canto and Ilha do Frade; premium-charter and corporate-shuttle anchor. Coordinate from OSM way 1166144073 (leisure=marina).

boarding_points.name: Marina Bay Vix
boarding_points.notes: Marina + lancha-tour and events venue on the Canal da Passagem (R. Vitalino dos Santos Valadares 175). Coordinate from OSM node 11514215248 (leisure=marina); existence confirmed via operator social channels.

boarding_points.name: Píer dos Pescadores da Praia do Suá
boarding_points.operator: Fishermen's community / tour operators (Capitão Grilo boarding point)
boarding_points.notes: Working fishermen's pier used as the Vitória-side boarding point for shared bay lancha tours (R$169/person). Coordinate resolved from the operator's official boarding-point map link.

boarding_points.name: Píer dos Pescadores da Prainha
boarding_points.operator: Fishermen's community / tour operators (Capitão Grilo boarding point)
boarding_points.notes: Vila Velha-side tour boarding pier ~80 m from the aquaviário station, below the Convento da Penha. Coordinate resolved from the operator's official boarding-point map link.

boarding_points.name: Ilha das Caieiras waterfront (moqueca restaurant row)
boarding_points.linked_locale: Vitória (Ilha das Caieiras — Santa Maria river mouth / urban mangrove)
boarding_points.notes: Gastronomy destination on the mangrove edge; already a scheduled dry-stop on commercial bay tours. Coordinate is the OSM locale centroid (neighbourhood on the waterfront) — exact pier to be pinned at survey.

boarding_points.name: Curva da Jurema beach
boarding_points.notes: The capital's urban beach and kiosk strip facing Ilha do Boi, minutes from Praça do Papa. Coordinate from OSM (beachfront); no fixed public pier verified — beach/pontoon boarding candidate.

boarding_points.name: Ilha do Frade waterfront
boarding_points.notes: Exclusive residential island between Praia do Canto and Ilha do Boi. Coordinate is the OSM island centroid; no public pier verified — premium-spur candidate pending access agreement.

boarding_points.name: Ilha do Boi waterfront
boarding_points.notes: Upscale residential island with two sheltered beaches at the bay mouth, opposite Vila Velha. Coordinate is the OSM island centroid; no public pier verified — premium-spur candidate.

boarding_points.name: Estação Centro (planned aquaviário station)
boarding_points.notes: One of three new stations ordered Mar 2026 (Centro + Dom Bosco share R$45M, ~18-month build). Exact waterfront site not yet published — coordinate withheld rather than guessed.

boarding_points.name: Estação São Pedro (planned aquaviário station)
boarding_points.notes: R$15M, ~180-day build per the Mar 2026 order of service. Exact waterfront site not yet published — coordinate withheld rather than guessed.

boarding_points.name: Estação Dom Bosco (planned aquaviário station)
boarding_points.notes: Part of the R$45M Centro/Dom Bosco package, ~18-month build. Exact waterfront site not yet published — coordinate withheld rather than guessed.
